title: Make Interfaces Feel Better：スキル＋画面＋依頼 → 直す場所・理由・同じJSON

status.authored: 8 source files of this conceptual introduction (index.html, concept.css, concept.js, video/index.html, video/video.css, video/video.js, video/storyboard.json, video/README.md), written by claude-opus-5-5
status.note: Written without running a browser, renderer, Node or tests. Rendering, frame review, encoding, packaging and publication are later steps by the production operator; nothing here claims they passed. This storyboard records the intended scenes, not an execution log.

composition.audio: none: no narration, TTS, audio guide, audio elements, audio scripts, audio assets or tracks; motionConfig.audioEvents is []

diagram.idea: One connected moving map shared with ../index.html (../concept.js). A book with five tabs, a request sheet and the real delivery-note page go into one 元のAI circle; a review lens marks three places on that same page and each place turns from the original before look into the original after look; three chips pair place and reason; a struck-through tray keeps the three rejected ideas; under the page one constant ribbon runs clips.json → export.mjs → JSON file. Portrait and wide are separate native arrangements of the same map.

nodes.book: SKILL.md / 19原則 / ＋5参照 with five tabs (typography, surfaces, animations, icons, performance). Markdown an AI reads; not an API, detector, model or five agents.
nodes.request: 依頼文 / quick: the original request.txt (target screen, main path, keep the styling system and the clips.json/export.mjs contract, up to 3 groups).
nodes.ai: One 元のAI circle: the original Opus run that read the fixed skill, request and source once and wrote the quick review and the after HTML/CSS/JS. It is not running now and never runs a browser or shell in the picture.
nodes.page: 納品メモ page with totals, three clip rows (c01–c03 titles and per-clip times from export.mjs), the notes option and the export button. Patch 1 rows: 16px box hit area grows to the whole row with a green focus ring on c02. Patch 2 totals: one proportional string → anchored equal-width slots whose digits roll in place. Patch 3 button: press 0.86 (colour-only gold done) → 0.96 with download → check icon cross-fade and 'ブラウザーへ渡しました'. Drawn sizes are illustrative, not measurements.
nodes.chips: 押せる範囲 16px→行全体 / 数字と状態 幅を予約 / 押下と手渡し 0.86→0.96, each tied to a numbered vermilion mark on the page edge; 'quick・上限3群 / 5分類とも記録' between them.
nodes.rejected: 変えない3案: 枠線→影, 見出しbalance, macOS平滑化, struck through; dashed branch from the AI.
nodes.contract: clips.json (3件・不変) → export.mjs (同じ関数) → JSON file showing the real byte size, count and time of the selected preset; label 同じ入力・同じ関数 → 同じJSON.
nodes.verify: Dashed 制作担当・別工程 / Node8条件・実DL確認 box beside the file: the original operator's separate verification, not shown being run again and not human approval.

diagram.explanatory_shapes: Book, sheets, lens, marks, chips, ribbon and tokens are diagram drawings, not execution evidence. The film never shows the AI running a CLI or browser, a new review, a score, an approval badge, uploads, waiting or error animations.

data.gate: concept/manifest.json (SHA-256 a4075c5d1bda1e89cbae006fd7d65268d9e1784704df569cd719c5bb738c1426) lists 34 frozen files; every file is checked for size and SHA-256 and the records for meaning before anything is drawn

invented inputs, outputs, waits or failures

limits: Make Interfaces Feel Better is Markdown guidance for an AI; the six parts are an explanatory grouping, not an upstream schema.
The before screen was made by Studio Yebisu with intentional hit-area, focus and state issues; the three clips are fictional metadata.
Drawn sizes illustrate the changes; 44px is the guideline, the original browser check observed rows of 82px or more.
Handing a file to the browser is not proof that it was saved to disk.
10% playback in the Animations panel was not available originally; durations ×10 in a private copy were the disclosed alternative. Busy, object URL error and HTTP 503 were controlled tests.
Physical iOS/Safari, VoiceOver, macOS, 200% browser zoom, human approval and general usefulness remain unverified.
crypto.subtle is required (HTTPS or localhost); without it the page and film stop with a clear message.
